posts.title: Squeezing a sokoban game into 10 lines of code
posts.description: If you’re only interested in seeing or playing the game, you can find it on my GitHub. The occasion The Haskell Tiny Game Jam is a game jam which challenges participants to write a video game in Haskell using 10 lines of 80 characters. I happen to love Haskell and code golf (abusing a programming language to produce disgustingly short code for fun) so I decided to enter the Feb ‘23 jam.
